title: Michael Aquino's ceremony at Wewelsburg Castle

tellings.quote: he conducted a ceremony at Vavsburg Castle, you know, the the Nazi SS Castle, some sort of satanic ceremony.

plain: An author, Peter Levenda, who wrote a book called Unholy Alliance, says that in the 1980s a man named Michael Aquino held a ceremony at Wewelsburg Castle in Germany, a castle used by the SS, Nazi Germany's elite force. Levenda describes it as some sort of satanic ceremony. It is told as a sign of a strange thread linking occult practice and old Nazi sites.
